henry.title: Gear Ratio Fractions
henry.intro: Engineers use fractions to design gears! A gear with 12 teeth turning a gear with 24 teeth turns it 1/2 a rotation.
steps: Explore the PhET Fractions sim for 5 minutes.
Bonus: design a gear pair that makes 1/3 turn.
worksheet: Shade 3/4 of a 4-tooth gear. Draw it.
A 30-tooth gear drives a 10-tooth gear. How many turns does the small one make per big turn?
A rocket fuel tank is 5/8 full. How much is empty?
links: Click 'Intro', pick a shape, and drag pieces in to build 3/4 and 2/3.

frankie.title: Super Counting Heroes
frankie.intro: Captain Count needs help counting things to save the city!
steps: Draw the right number of stars.
links: Tap the butterfly picture, then tap the arrows to add things and count them!
